R0047.title: CAPTCHA Bypass
R0047.definition: Passing human-machine tests through automated means.
R0047.description: Typically involves passing Turing tests (challenges used to distinguish machines from humans) in an automated manner. In addition to traditional image and audio CAPTCHAs, mini-games or arithmetic challenges may also be used. Commonly used during bulk automated operations to bypass human verification. With the advancement of AI technology, using computer vision and deep learning to automatically recognize CAPTCHAs has become a mainstream attack method. Beyond automated CAPTCHA solving, bypasses can also be achieved by altering the device environment or using third-party scripts to circumvent mouse movement trajectories, touch pressure, 3D gyroscope, and other behavioral biometric checks.

references.title: OWASP Automated Threat: OAT009 CAPTCHA Defeat

observables: The CAPTCHA endpoint is hit by a large volume of requests from CAPTCHA-solving service IP ranges within a short window
Mouse trajectories, touch pressure, and sliding rhythm of the same session exhibit mechanistic regularity in their parameters
CAPTCHA recognition response times are abnormally stable and below average human reaction time
Device sensor data such as gyroscope and accelerometer exhibits static or synthetic characteristics during the verification process
The CAPTCHA pass rate is abnormally stable across different time periods, inconsistent with the fluctuation curve of normal users
